question.text: If <math><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>12</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> touches <math><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>p</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>p</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mi>p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>, then the sum of all the possible values of <math><mi>p</mi></math> is

solution.text:
The distance of the centre p,p of the given circle from the line 4x+3y-12=0 is equal to the radius p
⇒4p+3p-125=p
⇒7p-12=5p or 7p-12=-5p
⇒p=6 or p=1
⇒ sum of all the possible values of ‘p’=6+1=7
